newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Highlights of Wednesday's Commission briefing.
newsitem.headline: Highlights of Wednesday's Commission briefing.

text.p: Following are highlights of the midday briefing by the European Commission on Wednesday:

Spokesman Joao Vale de Almeida said the Commission had approved, during its weekly meeting, a communication in preparation for the second Euro-Mediterranean Conference of foreign ministers to be held in Malta on April 15-16.
Vale de Almeida said the Commission intended to improve safety on aircraft operated by third countries and taking off from Community airports.

Vale de Almeida said the Commission had presented a concrete proposal to the IGC for a substancially revised Article 129 on health policy, as announced by Commission President Jacques Santer during a speech to the European Parliament on Tuesday.

Vale de Almeida briefed on the EU-South African negotiations that took place on Tuesday. He said the two parties had expressed the hope of finalising the protocol on partial South African membership of the Lome treaty in time for the next joint ACP-EU council that will take place in Luxembourg on April 24-25.
The Commission released the following documents:
- IP/97/130: The Commission wants to reinforce safety on aircraft operated by non-EU companies.
- IP/97/131: Euro-Mediterranean partnership: Preparation of the 2nd conference of foreign ministers, Malta, 15-16 April 1997.
- IP/97/132: ECU 27.5 million for economic restructuring to Rhine-Palatinat.
- IP/97/133: The Commission supports industrial reconstruction in Nordjylland, Denmark.
- IP/97/134: Industrial areas of Emilia-Romagna and Tuscany receive ECU 173 million.
- IP/97/135: The Commission orders Kesko Oy to divest the daily consumer goods business of Tuko Oy.
- IP/97/136: Customs: Commission decides to recover duties in seven individual cases.
- Speech/97/39: Speech by Commission President Jacques Santer to the EP debate on the report by the Committee of Inquiry into BSE.
- Memo/97/17: The Euro-Mediterranean partnership since the Barcelona conference 27-28 November 1995.
